items.title: Big or small chip, how do I know?
items.content: Look at the gold plate on your card. Clearly wider than it is tall (~11 × 8 mm), with a gap above the numbers: small chip, the most common on recent cards. Almost square (~13 × 11 mm), often right next to the numbers: big chip. Careful, some banks issue both: trust your card, not its model. The selector shows both shapes to scale, and the cut-out window adapts.

faq.intro: The answers to the questions we get asked the most.

items.q: Does the sticker interfere with the chip or contactless?
items.a: No. The chip window is pre-cut to the exact dimensions, so the chip stays fully exposed. The vinyl is thin enough to let contactless (NFC) through with no noticeable weakening. ATMs, card terminals, transit gates: everything works as normal.

items.q: Is it allowed by my bank? Is it legal?
items.a: Yes. The sticker only covers the plastic on the front face: it changes no data, leaves the chip fully exposed and alters neither the number nor the magnetic stripe on the back. Your card stays valid and accepted everywhere. Since it remains your bank's property, simply peel the sticker off — it lifts from a corner with no residue — before returning or renewing the card.

items.q: Could an ATM refuse or swallow my card?
items.a: No. The vinyl is ultra-thin: your card keeps its original thickness and slots into ATMs, card terminals and readers exactly as before. The pre-cut window keeps the chip clear, and the magnetic stripe on the back is never covered.

items.q: Does it work on every card?
items.a: Yes, on any card in the standard ISO format (bank, transit, ID badge). Cards with embossed (raised) numbers are compatible: the vinyl hugs the relief. Vertical cards too: the chip stays in the same physical spot.

The vinyl is built for real wallet life: rubbing, heat, repeated taps on terminals. Count on several years of normal use with no lifting at the edges. Fancy a change before then? Just apply a new design.

items.q: How do I apply the sticker cleanly?
items.a: Degrease the card (with the wipe from the kit or household alcohol), line the window up with the chip, then apply, smoothing from the centre outwards. If a small bubble appears, prick it with a needle and smooth it flat. The application kit (squeegee + wipe + microfibre) guarantees a flawless fit.

items.q: Can I remove the sticker? Will my card be damaged?
items.a: The sticker peels off by gently pulling from a corner, leaving no glue behind. Your card comes out intact. A removed sticker can't be reapplied: just order a fresh one (nice bonus: buy one, get one free).
Shipped within 48 working hours from France, as a tracked letter. Allow 2 to 4 working days within mainland France, 3 to 7 days across Europe. You get the tracking number by email.

items.q: What if my sticker has a defect?
items.a: A printing flaw or an imperfect cut? We'll send you a new sticker. Write to us using the form below with a photo, and we'll reply within 24 working hours.

contact.heading: Another question?
contact.subheading: A reply within 24 working hours, promise.

retours.title: Return policy
retours.introduction: This template is to be completed with your information and operational choices before publication. It is drafted for a business established in the United Kingdom selling online to consumers.

sections.title: 1. Contacting us
paragraphs: For any return, refund or replacement request, contact Geno Studio Ltd at hello@monkeysticker.fr, stating your order number, the item(s) concerned and the reason for your request. We will reply with the steps to follow.

sections.title: 2. Right to cancel
paragraphs: If you are buying as a consumer and no legal exception applies, you may cancel your order within 14 days of receiving the goods, without having to give a reason for your decision. This information is provided in particular under the Consumer Contracts (Information, Cancellation and Additional Charges) Regulations 2013.
To exercise this right, send us a clear statement of your decision before this period expires. You may use our cancellation form [TO COMPLETE: link or arrangements]; using it is not mandatory.
sections.notice: Period to verify before publication: after notifying us of your cancellation, you usually have a further 14 days to return the goods. Adapt this text to your sales markets and to any more favourable period you choose to offer.

sections.title: 3. Personalised items
paragraphs: The right to cancel does not apply to personalised stickers — created from your own artwork (the “Make your own” offer) or from any other specification you send us. Made and printed on demand, especially for you, they fall under the exception provided by the Consumer Contracts (Information, Cancellation and Additional Charges) Regulations 2013 for clearly personalised goods.

In practice: as long as printing has not started, you may ask us to cancel your order; once printing has begun, an order for a personalised product can no longer be cancelled or returned. This exclusion does not apply if the item is defective, damaged or not as described — in those cases, your rights remain in full (see “Defective, damaged or incorrect product”).

Catalogue stickers, which are not personalised, remain covered by the right to cancel above. For those items, we may deduct from your refund any loss in value resulting from handling beyond what is necessary to establish the nature, characteristics and proper functioning of the product.

sections.title: 4. Returning an item
paragraphs: When a return is justified (for example a cancellation of a non-personalised sticker), we will give you the address and arrangements: 6 rue Voltaire, 93100 Montreuil, France. As our orders ship from France, the return address is in France and is not that of the registered office in the United Kingdom — only use the address we give you, and do not send anything before receiving our instructions.

For a cancellation concerning a non-personalised item, you return the goods to us within 14 days of notifying your cancellation, at your own expense. Return costs are borne by us only if the item is defective, not as described or shipped in error. Keep proof of postage until the refund is confirmed.

sections.title: 5. Refunds
paragraphs: In the event of cancellation, we refund you within 14 days. As permitted by law, we may withhold that refund until we have received the returned goods or, if earlier, until you provide proof that you have sent them back — whichever comes first. The refund includes the cost of the initial standard delivery where the law requires it; return costs, however, remain your responsibility.
The refund is made using the payment method used when placing the order, unless expressly agreed otherwise, and at no cost to you.

sections.title: 6. Defective, damaged or incorrect product
paragraphs: If a product is defective, damaged on arrival or does not match your order, contact us promptly with photos and your order number. Our default solution is to reprint and re-ship the item free of charge, without you having to return it to us; depending on the case and your legal rights, a refund is also possible.
This policy does not limit your statutory consumer rights, in particular the rights applicable to goods that are not as described or defective.

pose.title: Applied in 60 seconds

intro.part2: , a wipe, a mini squeegee and a
intro.part3: . The cradle handles the alignment for you — all that's left is three simple moves.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Clean the front of your card with the wipe provided (one direction, no circles). Wait 10 seconds, then seat the card at the bottom of the cardboard cradle.

steps.title: Align — without sticking
steps.text: Sticker still on its backing: slide the two tabs into the cradle's slots. The window lands right on the chip. Nothing sticks yet, so take your time.

steps.title: Stick
steps.text: Fold the sticker over, peel off the bottom half of the backing, and press with your thumb from the centre outwards. Detach the tabs, pull the rest of the backing while pressing.

panic.title: Don't panic
panic.subtitle: The three things that can happen, and why none of them is a problem.

items.title: A few small bubbles?
items.content: Perfectly normal: they vanish on their own within 24-48 h. A big bubble? Push it towards the nearest edge with your nail or the mini squeegee provided.

items.title: Off to a bad start?
items.content: You have about 60 seconds to gently peel it off and start over — and there's a second sticker in your parcel, made exactly for this. Breathe.

items.title: Does your card have a raised (embossed) name?
items.content: Press for longer around the letters with your thumb. Slight bubbles may remain along the raised parts: that's normal and it fades away.

items.title: Really messed it up?
items.content: Use the second sticker from your parcel (buy one, get one free) and work through the steps one by one: the second attempt is almost always the good one.

cta.included: The cradle and the 2nd sticker are included with every order.

pose.metaDescription: Apply your bank card sticker perfectly the first time: alignment cradle included, 3 steps, 30-second video.

productPage.accDescriptionFallback: The « {name} » sticker dresses up your bank card at the exact ISO size (85.6 × 54 mm, rounded corners). The chip window is pre-cut: the chip stays visible and functional, and so does contactless. Thin vinyl that resists wallet wear, peels off without residue.
productPage.accApplicationContent: 1. Degrease your card (wipe included in the kit). 2. Peel the sticker and line up the left edge with the chip: the window guides you. 3. Squeegee from the centre out to the edges. Tip: the application kit makes for a perfect fit on the first try.
productPage.accShippingContent: Shipped within 48 h from France, by tracked letter (2–4 business days). A printing flaw? We'll send you a new sticker — just reach out via the contact page with a photo.

reviews.name: Léa M.
reviews.text: Super easy to apply, the window lands right on the chip. My card is unrecognisable (in a good way).

reviews.name: Thomas R.
reviews.text: Contactless works perfectly, no difference when paying. The matte finish is really clean.

reviews.name: Sarah K.
reviews.text: Second order, buy one get one free is great for switching it up depending on my mood.
